_doc: Standard experiment profiles for eval/experiment.py. Case lists are committed files (paths relative to the repo root); regenerate them with `python eval/experiment.py --regen-case-lists` (deterministic, seed below).

smoke.description: 5 fixed cases (subset of dev, at least one per set), current code only. Wiring check before spending credits.

dev.description: 50 fixed cases stratified across sets; current code vs. without KB hints vs. without the new safety layers vs. without the advisors.

full.description: All augmented cases (data/cases_aug/*), current code only.

v5-baseline.description: prompt v5-ko-ledger-review at the commit logged on 2026-09-26; run in a temporary git worktree with the current eval/ copied in, rescored with the current scorer

v6-no-safety.description: current checkout, new safety layers off (grounding, can't-miss gate, pre-test preconditions)

v6-no-advisors.description: current checkout, advisors off (code-confidence pushback, starting DDx + anchoring check, question planner, triage)

v6-no-interp.description: current checkout, code-first result interpreter off (no result-reading hint, no critical-result alert, no code findings in the ledger). Not in the dev profile (cost); run it explicitly when needed.

v6-no-subagents.description: current checkout, specialist sub-agents off (consult, advocate, LLM radiology: no extra LLM calls). Not in the dev profile (cost); run it explicitly when needed.
